summary: Several added docs overstate generic type relationships or omit a material forcing behavior.

items.issue: The extractor calls `s.tail`; a non-empty `Stream` evaluates its tail expression on that call. The comment singles out only the head as evaluated, omitting this material eager evaluation.
items.suggestion: State that extracting a `Stream` also evaluates its tail expression, or remove the evaluation claim.

items.issue: `T` is not checked against `runtimeClass1`: for example, `ClassTag[String](classOf[Int])` returns the shared `Int` tag cast to `ClassTag[String]`. The `@tparam` claims that `T` is the type whose erasure is the supplied class.
items.suggestion: Document the caller obligation to supply a runtime class compatible with `T`, rather than presenting that relation as guaranteed.

items.issue: The added documentation claims that `arg` manifests element type `T`, but `arg` is `Manifest[_]` and the implementation delegates to a cast-based factory. A caller can choose a mismatched `T`, yielding a manifest whose represented element type does not match its static result type.
items.suggestion: Document that callers must ensure `arg` represents `T`; apply the same correction to the identical added documentation on `ManifestFactory.arrayType`.
